diets.title: Weight Loss Diet
diets.breakfast: Greek yogurt with berries, chia seeds, and a drizzle of honey
diets.lunch: Grilled chicken salad with mixed greens, avocado, and olive oil dressing
diets.dinner: Baked salmon with steamed broccoli and quinoa
diets.snacks: Apple slices with almond butter, carrot sticks with hummus
tips: Avoid processed foods and sugary drinks
diets.notes: Consult a nutritionist before starting. Results vary based on activity level and metabolism.

diets.title: Weight Gain Diet
diets.breakfast: Oatmeal with banana, peanut butter, whole milk, and mixed nuts
diets.lunch: Grilled steak with sweet potato, brown rice, and steamed vegetables
diets.dinner: Pasta with lean ground beef, tomato sauce, and parmesan cheese
diets.snacks: Protein shake, trail mix, whole-grain crackers with cheese
diets.notes: Aim for 0.5-1 lb gain per week. Avoid junk food for unhealthy weight gain.

diets.title: Muscle Gain Diet
diets.breakfast: 4 egg omelette with spinach, whole-grain toast, and orange juice
diets.lunch: Grilled chicken breast, brown rice, black beans, and mixed vegetables
diets.dinner: Lean beef stir-fry with bell peppers, broccoli, and jasmine rice
diets.snacks: Cottage cheese with pineapple, protein bar, rice cakes with tuna
tips: Consume 1.6-2.2g protein per kg body weight
diets.notes: Pair with progressive overload training for best results. Stay hydrated during intense sessions.

diets.title: Fat Loss Diet
diets.breakfast: Scrambled eggs with spinach, mushrooms, and half an avocado
diets.lunch: Turkey lettuce wraps with cucumber, tomato, and mustard
diets.dinner: Grilled white fish with asparagus and cauliflower rice
diets.snacks: Hard-boiled eggs, celery with guacamole, handful of almonds
diets.notes: Combine with HIIT and strength training. Avoid extreme calorie restriction.

diets.title: Maintenance Diet
diets.breakfast: Whole-grain cereal with low-fat milk, banana, and walnuts
diets.lunch: Mediterranean bowl with hummus, falafel, tabbouleh, and pita
diets.dinner: Roasted chicken with roasted vegetables and wild rice
diets.snacks: Fresh fruit, yogurt, handful of mixed nuts
tips: Listen to hunger and fullness cues
Eat a variety of colorful foods
diets.notes: Adjust calories based on activity level. Regular health check-ups recommended.

diets.title: Vegetarian Diet
diets.breakfast: Smoothie bowl with spinach, banana, almond milk, granola, and seeds
diets.lunch: Chickpea curry with basmati rice and naan bread
diets.dinner: Stuffed bell peppers with quinoa, black beans, and cheese
diets.snacks: Edamame, fruit salad, whole-grain crackers with hummus
tips: Combine legumes and grains for complete protein
Include iron-rich foods with vitamin C
diets.notes: Ensure adequate protein, iron, zinc, and B12 intake. Consider consulting a dietitian.

diets.title: High Protein Diet
diets.breakfast: Protein pancakes with Greek yogurt and fresh berries
diets.lunch: Grilled shrimp with quinoa salad and lemon vinaigrette
diets.dinner: Herb-crusted chicken with roasted Brussels sprouts
diets.snacks: Jerky, protein shake, boiled eggs, string cheese
tips: Spread protein intake across all meals
diets.notes: Individuals with kidney conditions should consult a doctor before high-protein diets.

diets.title: Low Carb Diet
diets.breakfast: Avocado and smoked salmon on cloud bread with poached eggs
diets.lunch: Caesar salad with grilled chicken (no croutons) and parmesan
diets.dinner: Pan-seared pork chops with green beans and cauliflower mash
diets.snacks: Cheese cubes, olives, cucumber with cream cheese, nuts
diets.notes: Not suitable for everyone. Monitor energy levels and adjust as needed.
